ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) across the visible fluke surface with localized high-intensity (white/grey) pixel clusters at the margins and sparse internal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-contrast white pixel clusters localized at the left and right distal tips; scattered single-pixel high-intensity focal spots visible in the lower-left quadrant of the visible surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct acute V-shaped depression at the medial junction; depth is approximately 20% of the visible vertical lobe extension.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Generally smooth linear boundary along the medial trailing edge transitioning to high-frequency irregular pixel protrusions (amplitude 5-15 pixels) at the distal extremities.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves extending laterally and upward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-contrast white/textured pixels at both the left and right fluke tips; isolated white circular spots present on the mid-left lobe ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct light-grey linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally on the upper-right quadrant of the visible fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcareous barnacle encrustations on the outer margins of both fluke lobes, significantly altering the peripheral geometric profile.
